title: Floor layout
description: A hand-laid floor (D-150, Phase 15): its rooms on a grid of 8 m cells, the joins where two rooms' doors meet, the levers, the exits and the marked spots that each delve fills from the seed (encounters, chests, curios, traps — Phase 17). One file per floor at content/dungeons/<dungeon>/floors/<id>.json; templates are the dungeon's, halls are the kit's walls (hall-<kit>-h<n> / v<n>). Coordinates are game space: +x east, +z south; a room's local `at` is measured from its centre.

roomRef.description: A room's index in rooms[] (its id).

at.description: A point in the room's local game space, metres from its centre: [x, z].

templateId.description: A template of the dungeon, or a hall: hall-<kit>-h<n> (n cells east–west) / hall-<kit>-v<n> (north–south), n 1–3.

role.description: What the room is on this floor (the map's glyphs, Phase 17's fills). Omitted = plain.

name.description: A name for the map and the log ("the Hearth Shrine").

sideA.description: The side of room a the join is on; b's door faces back on the opposite side.

offsetA.description: The door's cell along a's side, from a's west (north/south sides) or north (east/west) corner.

kind.description: open: the kit's arch · wood: a leaf that opens with A · locked: the kit's barred door, opened by the floor's key · secret: the kit's panel, found with A (never gates: 07 §2.6) · lever: the kit's barred door, lifted by a lever.

opens.description: The index in joins[] of the lever join it lifts.

kind.description: entrance: the way in and out · stairs: the way down · side: a way out found from inside (D-151).

side.description: For entrance and side exits: the room's unjoined door the exit sits in (drawn as the open arch). Stairs use the room's stairs piece.

kind.description: key: the floor's key lies here (Phase 15 picks it up with A); the rest are filled by the seed in Phase 17.

id.description: A fixed curio, chest or encounter id, or null for the seed's pick.
